notes.title: Hotfix 9-10-2023
notes.notes: 1.0.0.40 Fixed crash (infinite loop) that happens when perching on one particular telephone pole.

notes.title: 9-8-2023 Notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug which was allowing pole climbing with item
-Unarmed takedown added! One of our favorites!

notes.title: patch 8-24-2023
notes.notes:
-Once again fixed the non-colliding lava bridge once and for all
-Unarmed Takedown added

notes.title: 1.0.0.37 notes
notes.notes:
-More steam deck optimizations. Everything should work fairly well with the right quality settings
-Acorn rewards for smashing ceramic, and picture frames
-Jogger challenge is now based on driving the RC Car

notes.title: Update notes 8-19-2023
notes.notes:
-Mostly Steam deck optimized, except for outfit select and some transparent things which are a bit sluggish
-much better grass
-Demo has an actual end
-RC CAR!

notes.title: beta patch 6/7/2023
notes.notes: Fixed various small bugs. Replaced black fur reward with red.
